tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250zhi ba bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis kyi sgos dzap las/ gtso bo yab yum ni/1$0000290 hūm̐ badzra dhṛk /mūṃ dhā twī shwa rī/

rigs bzhi yab yum ni/ oṃ dzi na dzik /lāṃ dwe ṣa rā ti/ swāṃ ratna dhṛk /māṃ mo ha rā ti/ āṃ a ro lik /pāṃ rā ga rā ti/ hāṃ pra dzñā dhṛk /tāṃ badzra rā ti/ sems dpa' yab yum brgyad ni/ kṣīṃ hi rā dza ya/ hūm̐ lā sai sa ma ya st+waṃ/ trāṃ ā garbha ya/ trāṃ mā le sa ma ya hoḥ hrī hā hūm̐ padma pra da ma/ hrīṃ gī tī rā go haṃ/ dzriṃ ku ru pā ṇi/ ā nirtī rā ga ya mye/ me dhā ra ṇe swā hā/ dzaḥdhū pe pra be/ thiṃlha nissa raṃ bha ya swā hā/ hūm̐ puṣpe ā be sha /hūm̐ swa rā dzā ya swā hā/ baṃ dī pa su gi rī/ muṃ shrī āṃ rā gā ya swā hā/ hoḥgandhe tsitta/ bya byed yab yum ni/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ badzra tsitta oṃ/ a a a badzrī bha dra sa manta āḥ thub pa drug ni/ oṃ mu ne kriṃ swā hā/ oṃ mu ne hūm̐ truṃ swā hā/ oṃ mu ne sruṃ swā hā/ oṃ mu ne braṃ swā hā/ oṃ mu ne kṣaṃ swā hā/ oṃ mu ne ye swā hā/ sgo ba yab yum ni/ hūm̐ ya mānta kṛta phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā badzra dha ro ma hā kro dhe shwa rī dzwa lī ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ hūm̐ pra dzñānta kṛta phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā ratna dha ro ma hā kro dhe shwa rī dzwa lī ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ hūm̐ padmānta kṛta phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā padma dha ro ma hā kro dhe shwa rī dzwa lī ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ hūm̐ bighnānta kṛta phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā karma dha ro ma hā kro dhe shwa rī dzwa lī ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces sgyu 'phrul zhi ba'i sgrub thabs ltar bris pa'o/ ༈ khrag 'thung nga brgyad kyi sgos dzap las/ gtso bo yab yum ni/ oṃ badzra shrī he ru ka hūm̐/ badzra kro dhe shwa rī st+waṃ/ khrag 'thung rigs bzhi yab yum ni/ oṃ bud dha shrī he ru ka hūm̐/ bud dha kro dhe shwa rī st+waṃ/ oṃ ratna shrī he ru ka hūm̐/ ratna kro dhe shwa rī st+waṃ/ oṃ padma shrī he ru ka hūm̐/ padma kro dhe shwa rī st+waṃ/ oṃ karma shrī he ru ka hūm̐/

karma kro dhe shwa rī st+waṃ/ gnas ma brgyad ni/ oṃ badzra gau rī haḥ oṃ badzra tsau rī haḥ oṃ badzra pra mo he haḥ oṃ badzra be tā lī haḥ oṃ badzra pukka sī haḥ oṃ badzra ghasma rī haḥ oṃ badzra sme sha nī haḥ oṃ badzra tsaṇḍa lī haḥ yul ma brgyad ni/ oṃ badzra siṃ ha mu khī he/ oṃ badzra byā ghri mu khī he/ oṃ badzra shriṃ gā la mu khī he/ oṃ badzra shwa nā mu khī he/ oṃ badzra gṛ ḍhā mu khī he/ oṃ badzra kaṅka mu khī he/ oṃ badzra kā ka mu khī he/ oṃ badzra u lū kā mu khī he/ sgo ma bzhi ni/ oṃ badzra ārya te dza te nga dzaḥ oṃ badzra a mu khī hūm̐/ oṃ badzra lo ka baṃ/ oṃ badzra bhasmi pa la ya ba tu hoḥ dbang mo nyer brgyad ni/ ma nu rakṣa sī bhyo/ brahma ṇī bhyo/ rau tri bhyo/ beṣṇa bai bhyo/ ku mā rī bhyo/ ind+ra ṇī bhyo/ badzra siṅga la bhyo/ a mṛtaṃ bhyo/ sau mya bhyo/ daṇḍa de bhyo/ rakṣa sī bhyo/ bhakṣa sī bhyo/ rā ti badzra bhyo/ ru dhi ra mattā bhyo/ e ka tsa ri ṇī bhyo/ ma no ha raṃ bhyo/ siddhi kaṃ bhyo/ bā ya bī bhyo/ ma hā mā ra ṇa badzra bhyo/ agnī bhyo/ bā ra hī bhyo/ tsa muṇḍī bhyo/ su ta naṃ bhyo/ ba ru ṇī bhyo/ badzra ma hā kā li bhyo/ badzra tsa kā la bhyo/ badzra kumbha karṇa bhyo/ badzra lambo da ra bhyo/ zhes sgyu 'phrul khro bo'i sgrub thabs ltar ro/// /
